reviews.text: County Line was quick and professional and got the job done right. I had a yellow jacket problem and that is what they took care of. No long contract for all kinds of servicesI didn’t need. Loved that the most! Thank you County Line.

reviews.text: Excellent service! I have not seen a single creepy crawly since they have been in. Booking and paying was fast and easy. They have a new forever client!

reviews.text: Justin was knowledgeable, friendly, punctual, and very helpful in helping me navigate a rodent problem in my apartment. Justin went above and beyond and helped fix a leaking kitchen sink while he was at my residence. Would recommend use County Line again.
